performance.verdict: Meta is carrying all leads; Google is spending $2,823 for 2 conversions.

findings.text: 6 overdue SOW milestones (pre-launch stack, LSA verification, site live, ads launch, Meta retargeting, Shoot 1) — all past due by 5–97 days; engagement is partially operational without verified infrastructure.
Google Ads spent $2,822.81 over 28 days for only 2 conversions; Meta spent $1,465.73 for all 33 leads — Google CPL is untrackably high vs Meta's $44.42.
3-day lead signal: Oct 4–6 averaged 1.67 leads/day vs Oct 1–3 average of 0.67 — a 2.5x improvement, driven by Meta spend recovering to $77.63 on Oct 6.
115 GHL opportunities created from 465 contacts over 28 days, 0 won and 0 appointments — leads arriving but no intake conversion, indicating a pipeline/intake process leak, not an ads problem.
Search clicks dropped 50% week-over-week (sc_7d_pct: -50) and GBP actions fell 8.33%, with 3 consecutive zero-GBP-action days (Oct 4–6) — organic visibility fading.

suggestions.text: Shift $15/day from Google Search to Meta, capping Google at ~$70/day until conversion tracking is confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: Move $15/day from Google Ads to Meta effective immediately, reducing Google daily budget from ~$85 to ~$70 and raising Meta accordingly. Google spent $2,822.81 for 2 conversions (28d) while Meta delivered all 33 leads at $44.42 CPL — the efficiency gap is confirmed. Success check: Meta CPL stays below $60 and weekly lead count holds at 12+ by 2026-10-14. If Google conversion tracking is verified working before then, revisit the split.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake leak: 115 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — audit routing and speed-to-lead immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 115 opportunities from 465 contacts over 28 days with zero won and zero appointments booked — leads are entering the pipeline but no contact or booking is occurring. Nacer to audit routing rules, auto-reply triggers, and calendar booking configuration this week. Success check: at least 1 appointment booked and confirmed in GHL by 2026-10-14. This is an ops/intake issue, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Watch Google Ads conversion tracking: 2 conversions on $2,823 may reflect pixel failure per known data-gap issue — confirm before killing.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads recorded only 2 conversions on $2,822.81 in 28 days, but client-side pixel issues are a known risk for this account. Nacer/Web to verify the Google tag and conversion actions are firing correctly via GTM — this was also an overdue SOW milestone. If tracking is confirmed broken, fix before making any further budget decisions on Google. Re-check by 2026-10-14.
